report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry contradicts the alert: gateway and order metrics show low error rate, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, p95 74ms, and traces/logs report OK/200. No public cause is supported, so no bounded candidate can be stated. Handing off for the alert's originating signal and dependency-level evidence.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows degraded checkout: traces, metrics and logs all report healthy (p95 74ms, error_rate 0.0014, status OK/200).
No evidence of http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak or bad-configuration in the admitted observations.
Need alert source and time window that triggered the checkout health degradation claim.
Need per-dependency latency/timeout metrics and error logs covering the alert window.
